currency: none (volumes in tonnes of crude palm oil)

grains.RAW.MILLS: one row per mill (city x sourcing model)
grains.RAW.MILL_DAILY: one row per mill per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.SUPPLIER_REGISTRY: one row per mill (FFB supplier registry snapshot)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day network-wide CPO dispatch FORECAST; mass-balance variance ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.CUSTODY_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic chain-of-custody follow-up SOPs (one per sourcing model and custody signal)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.TRACEABILITY_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.TRACEABILITY_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, mill, custody-signal and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (mills, daily CPO custody transfers, confirmed custody breaks by mill, custody-break risk, transfer events loaded) over an existing Snowflake data source
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose (Direct PUT) of CPO custody-transfer events -> S3 (transfers/) -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_TRANSFERS
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_TRANSFER_ALERT logs new FLAG events to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)
required_capabilities.custody_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(confirmed custody break in next 7 days) per mill, evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
